segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making the time, Dana. I was buried this morning typing notes into the CRM and cleaning up account records for deal desk, so it ate the window I had for buyer calls, but I’m glad we could still get 20 minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. I’ve got until 2:30. Main thing is we need to understand pricing for 48 users now, probably 60 by October.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. For 48 seats on the business plan, you’re at $84 per user per month on an annual term. That puts the subscription at $48,384 for the year before services.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: And the implementation line you sent was $9,500, right? Our finance team asked if that’s fixed fee or estimated.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Fixed fee. It includes the kickoff, two workflow sessions, data import support, and admin training. If you add the extra reporting workshop, that’s another $1,800, but it’s optional.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We’re trying to go live September 16. Is that realistic if legal gets the order form done by August 9?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, assuming we get the signed order and the first invoice processed that week. We’d target kickoff August 14 or 15, then leave about four weeks for configuration and testing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Payment terms are another question. Our standard is net 45, but your order form says net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can ask for net 45 approval. Usually that’s fine on annual deals over $40,000. I’ll note that the invoice should route to ap@northlineparts.com, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. Send the revised quote with 48 seats, net 45 if approved, and the September 16 go-live noted. I’ll forward it to our controller today.
